title: How Costco Really Makes Money (It's Not What You Buy)
description:
Costco sold about $297 billion of goods in fiscal 2026 — yet roughly half its operating profit came from a $65 plastic card. In this file we open the money machine behind Costco: Price Club in a Howard Hughes hangar, the 1983 Seattle warehouse, the membership model, the 14% markup rule, Kirkland Signature, the $1.50 hot dog, and the FY2026 numbers.

{CHAPTERS}

Sources: Costco Q4 and fiscal year 2026 results release; Costco FY2026 Form 10-K (SEC); The Shelby Report; Retail Insight Network; Zacks/Nasdaq; Fortune; Chowhound (Kirkland sales, 2026 annual meeting); Wikipedia (Costco, Costco hot dog).

All figures are from company reports where available and are rounded; the ~2% merchandise profit is our own arithmetic (operating income minus membership fees, divided by net sales). This video is for education only, not investment advice.
